acquisition_method.evidence: The DDA data analysis was performed for every measurement batch separately (5 technical replicates per batch) using MaxQuant (version 2.0.3.0) by searching against the UniProt Human Reference Proteome database (UP000005640_9606, 20950 entries) and an iRT PROCAL sequence database.
The DIA data was analyzed for every measurement batch separately (5 technical replicates per batch) using MaxDIA (version 2.0.3.0) with a library-based strategy.
